clauses.reason: This clause is the order's enacting words and sections 1-1 to 1-3: the establishment of the Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee and its membership (1-101, 1-102), its advisory, reporting and agreement-making functions (1-201 to 1-211) and its staff, support, information and compensation provisions (1-301 to 1-305). Every command in it operates only through the Committee. First end: the order's own sunset as amended. Section 1-402 of the original text ended the Committee on September 30, 1980; Section 1-102 of EO 12240 (signed 1980-09-26, four days before that date) rewrote Section 1-402 to provide that the Committee shall "terminate on September 30,1981". The Committee therefore ended on 1981-09-30 by its own terms as amended (read inclusively, the Committee exists through that day; the exclusive reading would end it when September 30, 1981 begins, and the packet holds nothing that fixes the hour). Section 22 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17) and Section 4(c) of EO 12399 (effective 1982-12-31) revoke the order later, so they are later events, not the first end. The revocation is of the whole order by number and carves out no clause. Executive Order 12240 amended this clause before the end: section 1-101 of that order added to section 1-303 a sentence providing for support under section 213 of the Independent Offices Appropriations Act, 1945 from October 1, 1980, and section 1-103 of that order raised the membership in section 1-102 from five to six persons; the clause continues, amended, to the sunset. The sunset itself is in section 1-402, the second clause.

research_rationale:
EO 12202 (Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee), signed 1980-03-18. The order establishes the Nuclear Safety Oversight Committee to advise on nuclear safety progress after the Three Mile Island accident (Sections 1-101, 1-102), sets its functions (1-2) and administrative provisions (1-3) and, in Section 1-402, its termination. EO 12240 (1980) extended the sunset by one year to September 30, 1981, raised membership from five to six and added a support sentence to Section 1-303. First end: the order's own sunset as amended. Section 1-402 of the original text ended the Committee on September 30, 1980; Section 1-102 of EO 12240 (signed 1980-09-26, four days before that date) rewrote Section 1-402 to provide that the Committee "terminate on September 30,1981". The Committee therefore ended on 1981-09-30 by its own terms as amended (read inclusively, the Committee exists through that day; the exclusive reading would end it when September 30, 1981 begins, and the packet holds nothing that fixes the hour). Section 22 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17) and Section 4(c) of EO 12399 (effective 1982-12-31) revoke the order later, so they are later events. Inventory corrected: the dossier's single clause (offsets 700 to 7081) stopped before section 1-4, so the held order text is covered by two clauses, the enacting words with sections 1-1 to 1-3 and section 1-4 (sections 1-401 and 1-402, which carries the sunset).
